capabilities: Search notes, tags, saved queries and commands from a Universal Palette
File notes into folders by adding #permanent or #archive tags
Capture fleeting notes with chosen folders and templates
Browse daily, weekly and yearly notes in a calendar
Show writing statistics, streaks and word counts
disambiguation: Not a note-merging or stitching tool; it files notes into folders based on tags.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. URL previews and remote images contact their source websites. Writing history starts when Seam begins recording it, though existing notes count toward vault totals. Interface available in English and Brazilian Portuguese; GPL-3.0 licensed.
motivation: To let users spend less time managing files and more time writing, using a Fleeting, Permanent and Archive workflow.
problem: Filing notes into folders by hand and switching between separate search, calendar and statistics tools interrupts writing.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Zettelkasten, Apple Notes, and Bear, it brings a simple Fleeting, Permanent, and Archive workflow
